sheets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. NEW character identity model sheet for a full-color fantasy manga, landscape 16:9. Input 1 is STYLE AND FACTION-CLOTHING reference only: match mature richly colored manga rendering and established-civilization fantasy materials, NOT copy any reference civilian's face. Create TWO clearly different adult characters on TWO HORIZONTAL ROWS. Each row has exactly FOUR evenly sized bust portraits of THE SAME PERSON: front neutral, three-quarter conversational, full side profile neutral, three-quarter specified emotional expression. Each face large, unobstructed, matching proportions consistently across all four views. Fine ink contours, refined cel shading, warm neutral parchment background, studio-neutral even light. No scenery distracting from faces. Understated hair/neckline differences, NOT same-face anime dolls. Anatomical differences in cheekbones, nose bridge, chin, brow and age MUST remain identifiable even if hair and clothes are hidden. Preserve same costume within each row. Label top small 「角色外觀提案」. Each row has the specified Traditional Chinese role label, plus tiny column labels 「正面」「斜側」「側面」「表情」. No fictional personal names, no numeric age, no backstory, no English, no watermark, no text that reveals secrets. Appearance candidates, not new playable heroes.
TOP ROW label 「銀葉王」. Very old male elf, visibly elder but lucid and dignified: elongated narrow face, high open forehead, long straight slender nose, deep-set sage-green almond eyes, thin arched grey brows, fine forehead/eye/cheek wrinkles, small firm chin, clean-shaven, long straight SILVER-WHITE hair swept behind pointed ears and loosely tied. Ivory robe with restrained green botanical embroidery, narrow understated leaf circlet. NOT beard wizard, not hunched decrepit, not evil. Fourth expression: warm absorbed curiosity, slight brow lift and soft smile, scholar interested in a discovery.
BOTTOM ROW label 「銀葉王子」. His ADULT experienced son, not teenager: substantial angular cheekbones, slightly broader lower face, firm tapered chin, long slightly convex nose sharing father’s nasal line, heavy straight dark brows, green-hazel almond eyes with mature lower lids, subtle smile lines, dark chestnut hair swept back with long half-tied length, pointed ears, no facial hair. Ivory-green high-collared diplomatic coat with flat gold leaf clasp, no battle armor, no crown. Fourth expression: attentive thoughtful concern, not anger. FAMILY resemblance through eyes and nose but DIFFERENT face silhouette and age from father. Prince looks visually middle adulthood, not youthful apprentice.

heroIntro.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. New full-color LANDSCAPE manga FIRST APPEARANCE sample page for established playable hero 雷恩. Input1 original game portrait is exact FACE AND COSTUME reference; input2 continuity sheet confirms ONLY far-left same hero, ignore other figures; input3 comic page is STYLE AND CITY reference. Preserve mature square face, thick brows, brown eyes, tousled chestnut hair, clean-shaven, white fur collar, blue gold armor, large blue gold shield. DO NOT turn him into a different face or name him guard commander. Modern fantasy era of established city, no modern technology. Five panels, actual sequential comic not character menu: left 45% large tall introductory panel; right 55% four panels in 2x2. Color manga linework like source3, precise faces, expressive poses, thin cream gutters. In large left panel, show hero three-quarter medium-full upright on city gate steps, shield on arm, looking toward citizens and carts; castle and organized bluegold helmeted halberdiers in depth. Face large and clearly readable. Place elegantly integrated dark blue/gold introduction cartouche beside torso NOT covering face or weapon: large exact 「守誓者・雷恩」 and smaller exact 「王國英雄」. At top small title 「城門前的守誓者」. No other rank/lore caption. Right top1: a helmeted guard reporting a backed-up caravan to hero, speech 「車隊和使團擠在一起了！」 Right top2: SAME hero closeup attentive firm, bubble 「先讓行人通過。」 Right bottom1: hero directs with hand while helmeted guards make a lane, bubble 「兩側留出通道。」 Right bottom2: family and cart safely proceed past hero seen in identifiable three-quarter profile, bubble from hero 「別讓人受傷。」 All text Traditional Chinese horizontal, sharp readable large balloons with clear tails. No extra words, no sinister plots, no new enemy. This is a replacement-layout PROPOSAL for existing gate-scene intro, not a new repeated chronological event.
